card.title: Playstation 4 Pro No Image and No Sound

source.title: Playstation 4 Pro No Image and No Sound

claims.statement: PS4 Pro no image/sound is most often the HDMI port or the MN864729 HDMI encoder; check the port (T-824 readings) and the 4 chokes between port and encoder (each carries 2 lines; continuity parallel, not across).
PS4 Slim and Pro share the same HDMI port, chokes and MN864729 encoder.

procedure: Inspect port and solder joints; compare T-824 readings.
Check MN864729 for damage, shorts and missing voltages.
Hot-swap the port, replace chokes or encoder (preheat).
card.caveats: Encoder voltages are only shown in an image. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
